extracted.intended_audience: media activists, community organizers, advocacy groups, and concerned citizens seeking to challenge unfair coverage and promote independent media
extracted.subtask_description: A practical toolkit for identifying, documenting, and challenging inaccurate or unfair news coverage and for promoting and building independent media through community organizing and grassroots pressure. Includes guides, contact lists, resources, and suggested uses for organizational and educational settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify inaccurate or unfair news coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Inside this kit you will find 'how-to' guides for identifying... inaccurate or unfair news coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides provide methods for spotting inaccuracies and unfair framing in news stories so activists can recognize when media coverage harms their issues or communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document unfair coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: 'How-to' guides for... documenting... inaccurate or unfair news coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documentation is presented as a discrete task (collecting clippings/screenshots, recording instances) that supports challenges and outreach; the kit encourages bookmarking or screenshotting pages for later use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Challenge inaccurate or unfair coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: 'How-to' guides for... challenging inaccurate or unfair news coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Challenging is framed as an active step following identification and documentation; the kit contains strategies and resources to mount effective challenges (letters, community pressure, media outreach).

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote and build independent media
rubrics_metrics.description: The kit contains information about how to promote independent media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promotion of independent media is presented as an equally important component of media activism alongside challenging corporate media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balance challenging corporate media with building independent media
rubrics_metrics.description: Challenging corporate media and building independent media are equally important components of media activism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strategy should include both critique of mainstream outlets and proactive support/creation of independent outlets rather than focusing solely on one approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use long-term community pressure and grassroots action
rubrics_metrics.description: Long-term community pressure and grassroots action are key to media reform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes sustained, organized local efforts over one-off protests; implies strategies should be durable and community-based.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preserve and reuse kit materials for organizational purposes
rubrics_metrics.description: We encourage you to bookmark or screenshot pages for use in organizational meetings, educational forums, mailings to your members that urge media action, or any other useful situation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Materials are intended to be redistributed and reused in trainings, meetings, and member communications to facilitate coordinated media activism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use FAIR's compiled resources (guides, contact list, resource list, readings, groups)
rubrics_metrics.description: Contents include FAIR’s Media Literacy Guide; Organize!; FAIR’s Media Contact List; FAIR’s Resource List; Recommended Reading; Media Activism Groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The kit bundles multiple resource types — educational guides, contact databases, reading lists, and group directories — which should be used in combination to plan and execute media actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seek support and share information with FAIR staff
rubrics_metrics.description: Please don’t hesitate to contact the FAIR staff with any information or questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FAIR offers assistance and a point of contact for activists seeking advice, reporting problematic coverage, or coordinating action; users are encouraged to communicate back to the organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aim to win greater media access for independent voices
rubrics_metrics.description: We hope that this packet will help you fight unfair coverage of your issues and communities, and win greater access in media for independent voices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The overarching measurable goal of actions using the kit is increased access and fairer representation of marginalized or independent perspectives in media.
